name: La Llagosta (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the red locust of the arms facing the hoist.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 27 October 1998; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the red locust of the arms (approved 15 April 1997) facing the hoist at the centre, one third of the height; the locust is the traditional sign of the town.

features.role: locust (llagosta) facing the hoist, one third of the height
